action.objective: Verify the broad-search suggestion f2g3, which recaptures the g3 pawn and had the best exact depth-4 score (-408).
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 4 over all legal moves found f2g3 as the top exact-scored candidate (-408), better than g1f1 (-409, upper bound so possibly worse) and d1f1 (-433, upper). It captures the intruding g3 pawn, eliminating Black's promotion threat on g2, and keeps the king relatively sheltered. Others' upper bounds carry hidden risk, so verifying the exact-scored suggestion first is the sound approach.
